meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: Claude 会在分发、扫描、解析、生成卡片等操作节点记录事件，产出按 trace_id 串联的证据链与向量索引，并给出按条件检索历史证据的接口。
howto.when: 当你为多智能体系统做全链路可观测或安全审计时使用；各官署在关键操作节点调用它，或通过事件总线异步推送事件时接管。

say.text: 把这次分发事件写入留痕：actor 是军机处，trace_id 用 T-001
say.note: 写入证据链并更新向量索引。

say.text: 按 trace_id T-001 检索完整证据链
查最近一小时各官署的操作记录
say.note: 返回该时间窗内的检索结果。

howto.what_en: Claude records events at each dispatch, scan, parse, and card-generation step, produces a trace_id-linked evidence chain plus vector index entries, and exposes a query interface for past evidence.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need end-to-end observability or security auditing for a multi-agent system. It takes over when agencies call it at key steps or push events over the event bus.

say_en.text: Log this dispatch event: actor is the Grand Council, trace_id T-001
say_en.note: Writes it into the evidence chain and index.

say_en.text: Retrieve the full evidence chain for trace_id T-001
Show all agency operations from the past hour
say_en.note: Returns results for that time window.
